snippet.title: FERALPALS: Chapter 01 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Feralpals Chapter 1 NOW: https://polypaw.itch.io/feralpals


In an unknown year, humans mysteriously went extinct after a disease caused by the Friendly Pals. Originally animal creatures genetically modified and given human-like intelligence for mankind's own purposes, the Pals simply picked up where humans left off—building lives, families, and a future of their own.

You play as Dan the Dog, a little guy who gets a phone call from his best friend, Basil the Bat, inviting you to an old forest campsite to reunite with childhood friends. But this forest hides a dark past of what is buried inside, and is humanity truly extinct?

About the Game:
Feralpals is a story-driven, chapter-based horror game created by Polypaw, with this release being Chapter 01: Old Friend. Chapter 1 is 30 to 45 minutes in length.

Want to see what happens next? If you enjoyed Chapter 1 and are interested in supporting the development of future chapters, you can leave a donation here : https://buymeacoffee.com/itspolypaw
